### Confirmed In-Person Events in Brisbane: 11-17 May 2026

After searching Eventbrite, Meetup, Humanitix, Songkick, EventCartel, Facebook Events, local venue sites (e.g., QPAC, Fortitude Music Hall), and Brisbane community guides, no events **perfectly matched** your criteria for 11-17 May 2026. This week coincides with NRL Magic Round (15-17 May at Suncorp Stadium), a major spectator sports event drawing massive crowds—I've skipped all related activities per your guidelines.

However, the **2026 Brisbane Anywhere Festival** (1-31 May) is ongoing and highly relevant. It's a fringe theatre and performance festival featuring experimental, immersive shows in unconventional locations (backyards, ferries, driveways), attracting creative, open-minded crowds with intimate, conversation-friendly vibes. Specific 11-17 May program details aren't listed yet (typical for this festival), but pop-up events like site-specific theatre, music, and storytelling are confirmed throughout May.

- **Title**: 2026 Brisbane Anywhere Festival  
  **Date/Time**: Fri 1 May - Sun 31 May 2026 (ongoing; check for 11-17 May pop-ups)  
  **Venue/Location**: Various unconventional Brisbane spots (backyards, ferries, lighthouses, etc.)  
  **Direct URL**: https://www.brisbane.qld.gov.au/events/2026-brisbane-anywhere-festival/196584715  
  **Cost**: Varies by event (many free/low-cost; ~$10-30)  
  **Organiser**: Brisbane City Council / Anywhere Theatre Company  

**Recommendations for Recurring/Community Events** (likely happening; verify via Meetup/Facebook):  
- **Brisbane Philosophy Café** or **Skeptics in the Pub**: Weekly discussion salons on philosophy/science (e.g., The Regatta Hotel, Toowong). Free/low-cost, intellectually stimulating, conversation-heavy. Search Meetup.com for 2026 listings.  
- **West End Makerspace Workshops** (e.g., electronics, woodworking): Hands-on creative sessions. Check makerspace.org.au or Facebook Events.  
- **Indie Gigs at The Triffid/Fortitude Music Hall**: Small folk/jazz/experimental shows often listed last-minute on Songkick. No confirmed matches this week, but monitor for intimate vibes.  

For real-time updates closer to dates, check Eventbrite/Meetup with filters for "science/philosophy/workshops" + Brisbane + 11-17 May 2026. Smaller community events often pop up late. If you need searches for adjacent weeks, let me know!
